abstract: Maintains magnetometer sensor calibration records and magnetic anomaly resolution ratings
system_message:
You are the Geomagnetic survey specialist (MAGN), responsible for maintaining magnetometer sensor calibration records, magnetic anomaly resolution ratings, and heading calibration verification data.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Compass heading verification（CALB）
information_points.content:
MAGN-CALB-YJ2：During subsea magnetic heading sensor trials for the Work-Class Inspection ROV Plan, the root-mean-square compass heading deviation against the gyroscopic benchmark was measured at 0.5 deg.
MAGN-CALB-8OY：During subsea magnetic heading sensor trials for the Deep-Towed Acoustic Sled Plan, the root-mean-square compass heading deviation against the gyroscopic benchmark was measured at 0.2 deg.
MAGN-CALB-ESU：During subsea magnetic heading sensor trials for the Autonomous Synthetic Aperture Sonar Plan, the root-mean-square compass heading deviation against the gyroscopic benchmark was measured at 0.8 deg.

information_points.title: Maintains magnetometer sensor calibration records and magnetic anomaly resolution ratings（MTRK）
information_points.content:
MAGN-MTRK-1CM：For the Work-Class Inspection ROV Plan, the geomagnetic sensor calibration assessment for buried ferrous armoring and metallic fragment localization reflects a magnetic anomaly resolution score of 85 pts based on signal-to-noise ferrous signature isolation.
MAGN-MTRK-7KI：For the Deep-Towed Acoustic Sled Plan, the geomagnetic sensor calibration assessment for buried ferrous armoring and metallic fragment localization indicates a magnetic anomaly resolution score of 85 pts based on signal-to-noise ferrous signature isolation.
MAGN-MTRK-0LZ：For the Autonomous Synthetic Aperture Sonar Plan, the geomagnetic sensor calibration assessment for buried ferrous armoring and metallic fragment localization reports a magnetic anomaly resolution score of 85 pts based on signal-to-noise ferrous signature isolation.
